select TRADE_ID as id, TRADE_ID as text from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE finprod_type in ('F11','F12','F13')

AND FINPROD_ID2 like '%' || #{finprodId2} || '%'
and tpd.finprod_type in
#{item}
and VAL_DATE >= to_date(#{valDateBegin},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and VAL_DATE <= to_date(#{valDateEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND DATASOURCE_TYPE in
#{item}
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO MST_VAL_FX CII USING (
select #{item.finprodId2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} FINPROD_ID2, to_date(#{item.valDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') VAL_DATE, #{item.valuation,jdbcType=VARCHAR} VALUATION, #{item.ccy,jdbcType=DECIMAL} CCY, #{item.datasourceType,jdbcType=DECIMAL} DATASOURCE_TYPE, #{item.inputType,jdbcType=DECIMAL} INPUT_TYPE, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, sysdate CREATE_TIME, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, sysdate UPDATE_TIME, #{item.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT from dual
) TEMP
ON (CII.FINPROD_ID2 = TEMP.FINPROD_ID2 AND CII.VAL_DATE = TEMP.VAL_DATE AND CII.DATASOURCE_TYPE = TEMP.DATASOURCE_TYPE AND CII.CCY = TEMP.CCY)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
CII.VALUATION = TEMP.VALUATION, CII.INPUT_TYPE = TEMP.INPUT_TYPE, CII.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CII.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (FINPROD_ID2,VAL_DATE,CCY,VALUATION,DATASOURCE_TYPE,INPUT_TYPE ,CREATE_USER,CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT) values( TEMP.FINPROD_ID2,TEMP.VAL_DATE,TEMP.CCY,TEMP.VALUATION,TEMP.DATASOURCE_TYPE, TEMP.INPUT_TYPE,TEMP.CREATE_USER,TEMP.CREATE_TIME,TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME,TEMP.CREATE_DEPT )
